probe: sf-property-view against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20; simai/ui-pro#3, #4)
format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is the SIMAI Framework's tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs through tests/browser/package-manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: an applied group save is the fact sf-property-view-saved {id, revision}, once

steps.script: (() => { window.__calls = []; let revision = 1; const record = (id) => ({record_id: id, collection: 'workbench.solutions', revision: String(revision), label: 'Портал клиента', editable: true, actions: ['record.edit'], address: '/admin/r1', sections: [{key: 'main', label: 'Основное', groups: [{key: 'g', label: 'Главное', columns: 1, fields: [{key: 'title', label: 'Название', propertyType: 'string', width: 'full', value: 'Портал клиента'}]}]}, {key: 'links', label: 'Связи', groups: [{key: 'l', label: 'Ссылки', columns: 1, fields: [{key: 'site', label: 'Сайт', propertyType: 'string', width: 'full', value: 'simai.io'}]}]}]}); const port = {id: 'simai.property-view-port', version: '1.14.0', capabilities: [], raise: async (intent, payload) => { window.__calls.push(intent); if (window.__never) return new Promise(() => {}); if (intent === 'record.load') return payload.record_id === 'r1' ? {answer: 'applied', record: record('r1')} : {answer: 'refused', reason: 'record-unknown', message: 'Запись не найдена'}; if (intent === 'group.save') { revision += 1; return {answer: 'applied', revision: String(revision), record: record('r1')}; } return {answer: 'unavailable', reason: 'capability-not-provided'}; } }; document.querySelectorAll('sf-property-view').forEach((one) => one.setHostPort(port)); return true; })()
(() => { const el = document.getElementById('p'); const field = el.sections[0].groups[0].fields[0]; el.changeField(field, 'Портал клиента 2'); return true; })()
